data.desc: Headquartered in Los Angeles, CA, LiveOne (Nasdaq:LVO) is an award-winning, creator-first music, entertainment and technology platform focused on delivering premium experiences and content worldwide through memberships and live and virtual events. LiveOne's subsidiaries include Slacker Radio, PodcastOne (Nasdaq:PODC), PPVOne, CPS, LiveXLive, DayOne Music Publishing, Drumify and Splitmind.
